slides.author: Alexey Grigorev
slides.title: Agent observability starts with ingestion
slides.subtitle: Before dashboards, you need traces in a queryable destination.

slides.title: Traces live in many places
slides.body: They can come from local files, Logfire, Langfuse, platform APIs, internal loggers, or vendor APIs.

slides.title: Each source has a shape
slides.body: Tool calls, model usage, sessions, spans, inputs, outputs, and metadata may be represented differently.

slides.title: The first job is ingestion
slides.body: Collect traces, load them somewhere queryable, preserve the fields you need, and validate the resulting structure.

slides.title: Then you can inspect behavior
slides.body: Ask which models are used, which tools are called, which sessions fail, and where performance problems appear.

slides.supportingText: Alena Astrakhantseva shows this with dlt and agent traces.
